page: Amazon Web Services c6id.12xlarge is a compute-optimized instance powered by the Nitro hypervisor. It features an Intel Xeon 8375C processor with 48 vCPUs and 24 physical cores running at 3.5 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The hardware configuration includes 96.0 GB of DDR4 memory operating at 3 GHz, providing 2.0 GB of RAM per core. For local storage, the instance is equipped with 2850 GB of NVMe SSD instance store volumes. Network performance features a baseline bandwidth of 19 Gbps.

Benchmark results indicate strong performance in specific vector and cryptographic workloads. The processor supports AVX, AVX512F, AVX512_VNNI, and AES instructions, contributing to a strong Geekbench ray tracing score of 50081.0 and a strong image processing score of 15412.0. Passmark CPU encryption tests also show strong results at 43659.0. In LLM inference tests using a small 135M model, the instance achieves 2456.37 tokens per second for prompt processing and 306.31 tokens per second for text generation. Other metrics, such as the Geekbench multi-core score of 15844.0 and the Redis SET throughput of 45.49 million operations per second, fall within the average range.

The c6id.12xlarge offers a balanced profile for compute-intensive applications requiring high-speed local storage. The inclusion of 2850 GB of NVMe SSD local storage directly on the instance provides high-speed, low-latency data access without the added cost of external block storage volumes, enhancing qualitative cost efficiency for temporary data processing. This instance is well-suited for workloads such as software compilation, database operations, video encoding, and localized machine learning inference.
